visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short black hair, wearing a white oversized t-shirt and a black protective mask, stands outdoors at night. He holds a camera in a selfie position, speaking excitedly with wide eyes. Behind him is a modern building with glass panels and warm interior lighting. (2) The screen switches to a secondary video overlay showing a young woman with a ninja headband. She is in a bedroom setting with soft lighting, wearing a red tank top and a black track jacket, performing intricate finger movements and hand seals while looking into the camera. (3) The male creator returns to the selfie view, standing in a brightly lit hallway. He looks around and gestures with his hands, displaying a confident facial expression behind his mask. The background includes white pillars and people walking in the distance. (4) In a large, high-ceilinged transit hub with a glossy floor and modern architecture, the male creator performs a series of rapid-fire hand signs. He wears a black crossbody bag. Passers-by in casual clothing walk past him, some looking at his energetic movements. (5) The creator leans towards the camera, his hand coming close to the lens to signify the end of the video. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his white t-shirt and the bustling public environment of the train station behind him.
